MIG_W_ADDRESS_UNPARSED.meaning: An address couldn't be split into its parts; it is kept in the contact's notes

MIG_W_ASSIGNEE_FOREIGN.meaning: The card was assigned to someone else; the user is responsible now

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD_ONLY.meaning: A type v2 uploads refuse (svg, gif, bmp): it migrates as a download-only file (D-13)

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_NOT_MIGRATED.meaning: A file or embedded image on a card that becomes a personal task has no matter to go on, so it is not migrated

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_MISSING.meaning: The attachment's file is not in legacy Storage; the document is kept, with nothing to copy

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_OVERSIZE.meaning: The file is over the 25 MB legacy limit; it still migrates

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MISMATCH.meaning: The attachment's recorded size differs from its file's; the file's size is used

MIG_W_ATTACHMENT_TYPE_FROM_EXTENSION.meaning: The attachment had no content type, so it comes from the file extension

MIG_W_BUDGET_MISSING.meaning: The profile has no financial year budgets (older profiles)

MIG_W_BUDGET_ROLLED_OVER.meaning: The profile's budget year is before the current one, so this year has no budget (legacy rollover)

MIG_W_BUDGET_YEAR_MISSING.meaning: A budget has no financial year, so it is read as the current one (the year before, for the previous budget)

MIG_W_CALENDAR_EVENTS_EXIST.meaning: A checklist item had a calendar event, which is still in the user's calendar

MIG_W_CHECKLIST_TRUNCATED.meaning: A card's checklist had more items than a personal task holds; the rest were dropped

MIG_W_DATE_INVALID.meaning: A date could not be read. Instants use the export time instead; due and billing dates are left unset

MIG_W_EMAIL_INVALID.meaning: An email address isn't valid; it is kept in the contact's notes

MIG_W_FEE_DISBURSEMENTS.meaning: The legacy fee recorded disbursements; they are kept on the matter for review, not as records

MIG_W_FEE_FOLIO.meaning: Billed by folio in legacy: hourly in v2, with a note (D-06)

MIG_W_FEE_TYPE_MISSING.meaning: The card has no billing type: hourly with no estimate, for review

MIG_W_FEE_TYPE_UNKNOWN.meaning: The billing type is not one the legacy app had: hourly with no estimate, for review

MIG_W_HTML_UNSAFE_REMOVED.meaning: Rich text held scripts, styles, frames or similar, which were removed

MIG_W_INLINE_IMAGE_EXTRACTED.meaning: An image embedded in a description became a document on the matter

MIG_W_INTEGRATION_NOT_MIGRATED.meaning: A legacy integration is not migrated; the user reconnects it

MIG_W_LABEL_UNKNOWN.meaning: A label id the board no longer defines was dropped

MIG_W_LINK_DROPPED.meaning: A linked card isn't migrated as a matter (another board, or deleted), so the link is dropped

MIG_W_MATTER_REFERENCE_DUPLICATE.meaning: A matter reference repeats, so a new number is allocated (it stays the external reference)

MIG_W_NON_PRIME_WORKSPACE.meaning: A non-prime workspace is listed in the report, not migrated

MIG_W_NOTE_TRUNCATED.meaning: Text longer than a note's limit was cut

MIG_W_ORG_NAME_UNCONFIRMED.meaning: The org name comes from the legacy company name; the user confirms it at cutover (D-09)

MIG_W_PERSON_MISSING.meaning: A referenced user has no legacy profile, so their name is unknown

MIG_W_PHONE_INVALID.meaning: A phone number isn't a valid number; it is kept in the contact's notes

MIG_W_PRIORITY_UNKNOWN.meaning: A priority outside 0 to 3 was read as none

MIG_W_REFERRER_MISSING.meaning: The card names a referrer that is not exported

MIG_W_REFERRER_NO_TIMESTAMPS.meaning: The referrer has no dates, so the export time is used

MIG_W_REFERRER_UNNAMED.meaning: The referrer has neither a name nor a company

MIG_W_REMOTE_IMAGE_DROPPED.meaning: Rich text loaded an image from the web (a tracking pixel, say), which was dropped

MIG_W_SWIMLANE_UNKNOWN.meaning: The card's column isn't on the board any more, or the profile doesn't map it

MIG_W_TEMPLATE_EMPTY.meaning: A checklist template had no items, so it is not migrated

MIG_W_TEMPLATE_ID_MISMATCH.meaning: The checklist template's id field differs from its document id; the document id is used

MIG_W_TEMPLATE_TRUNCATED.meaning: A checklist template had more items than v2 allows; the rest were dropped

MIG_W_TEXT_TRUNCATED.meaning: A title, name or group longer than v2 allows was cut

MIG_W_UNTITLED.meaning: A record had no title, so a placeholder title is used

MIG_W_UPDATED_BEFORE_CREATED.meaning: The record says it was updated before it was created; updatedAt is set to createdAt
